issues.on_page: Charge for services 112,049 (Water and Sewer funds)
issues.issue: Water/sewer fund charges should be 'Utility Charges' (user rule 2026-10-28). The matching detail lines (detail[20], detail[21]) already use Utility Charges, so the same label has two categories in this report.

The report itself doesn't add up. The fund cells net to 674, but the Total column prints 673. The Water column's net change (computed 13,127) also differs from the printed 13,126. Neither is in report_discrepancies. Business-type detail other financing nets to 674 against business_type.transfers_net of 673.
The capital outlay rule (2026-10-26) relabels this as 'Capital Outlay: Utilities' with the printed text kept in printed_label. This is not applied here or on detail[33].
